reason: The text does not address the relative superiority of priest leaders versus non-priest leaders. The passage focuses on the conflict between Moses and Aaron (God's messengers) against Pharaoh's resistance to releasing Israel. While Aaron is identified as a priest and the Egyptian magicians (חרטומים) also function in priestly roles, their failure is attributed to God's superior power rather than to any inherent inferiority of priestly leadership. The text's central concern is obedience/disobedience to God's will, not the comparative authority or superiority of different types of leaders based on priestly status.
